scope: Independent exact-hash Product Owner review of the revised local billing/share evidence inventory and its named source claims. Evidence-document disposition only; no implementation or payment/provider authority.
delegation: The human user explicitly delegated product and technical choices to this Product Owner Agent. This review does not claim human legal, financial, security-owner, provider, production, deployment, release, or merge signoff.

review_history.reason: The evidence inventory omitted the same-event retry failure after a durable webhook event insert and post-insert processing failure.
The retry omission was corrected and the failure-injection prevention gate was added, but frontmatter version 0.2.0 did not match the last changelog row, 0.1.0.
The current draft records the retry control-flow gap, preserves explicit NOT_RUN boundaries, and aligns frontmatter version 0.2.1 with the latest chronological changelog row.

verified_claims: The three handlers, helper tests, SQL test, and CR-003 parent/checklist references are described as static evidence, distinct from executed behavior.

The same-event retry note accurately follows payment-webhook/index.ts: a durable event insert precedes charge re-fetch; a later 500/502 can be followed by a duplicate-key 200 before re-fetch or credit is retried.
The draft marks this as static control-flow inference, not an observed runtime or production loss, and records handler retry failure-injection testing as NOT_RUN.
The proposed prevention gate is limited to a future isolated fake-dependency test/contract and explicitly does not decide or authorize a code fix.
The SQL file declares plan(63), and its DB-05/DB-12 cases are sequential rather than proof of simultaneous-session concurrency.
The 2026-07-18 go-live checklist statements, including 69/69 pgTAP and Omise/project status, are treated as dated historical assertions rather than current state.

The charge-before-order-insert boundary, provisional scoring/receipt rules, unverified Omise sandbox assumptions, and missing endpoint-level test coverage are identified without promoting them to approved policy.
The evidence-limit and activity rows identify the assigned handler/helper/SQL review and the supplemental CR-003 parent/checklist context.
Frontmatter version 0.2.1 matches the final chronological changelog row.
limitations: No handler, Deno test, SQL/pgTAP test, Supabase stack, database, concurrency harness, provider sandbox, production project, package activation, migration, or payment flow was executed.
The retry consequence is source-level control-flow analysis only; no actual lost payment, uncredited order, or current external state is asserted.

This approval is for a source-grounded evidence draft only. It does not authorize code changes, failure recovery work, reconciliation, provider configuration, transactions, deployment, legal review, production, release, or merge.
